Cuts the learning rate when the validation loss stops improving.

torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(mode='min', threshold_mode='abs', cooldown=0) on the validation loss, stepped after each epoch that ran validation. Needs validation data.

| --- | --- |

| Status | Runs |

## Outputs

None: the node ends a branch of the graph.

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Schedule | Factor | `factor` | Number | `0.1` | `0.0-0.999999` | The run | Factor applied when the loss plateaus. |
| Schedule | Patience | `patience` | Integer | `10` | `0-1000000` | The run | Validated epochs without improvement before a cut. |
| Schedule | Threshold | `threshold` | Number | `0.0001` | `0.0-1000000.0` | The run | Smallest decrease of the validation loss that counts as improvement (absolute) |
| Schedule | Minimum learning rate | `min_lr` | Number | `0.0` | `0.0-1000000.0` | The run | Learning rate floor. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Usage

```text
After each epoch that ran validation: if the loss is not below best - threshold for more than patience epochs, lr = max(lr * factor, min_lr) (torch ReduceLROnPlateau, mode='min', threshold_mode='abs', cooldown=0).
```

## Tips

- With validation_freq above 1 it steps only on validated epochs.
- Good when the right schedule is unknown.
